live_local.environment: Actual Kubernetesv1.35.0/etcd3.6.6, systemd/static-Pod/SSH operations in isolated privileged Docker nodes; HA3realcontrolplanes plusTCPloadbalancer. Native UbuntuVM compatibility requires hosted verification.
details: Audit checks all four required Deployment verbs and a fresh Secret event.
Encryption checks all captured existing Secret keys and a fresh write; valid plaintext mutation is rejected.
Kubelet checks anonymous401, unauthorized authenticated token403, closed read-only port and working authenticated logs/exec.
HA checks actual control-plane joins, writes with one member stopped, and all-member recovery.
Host hardening rejects an otherwise unprivileged service that retains a capability bounding set.
Existing allowed Pod executes a real command while the ImagePolicyWebhook service is stopped.

semantic_audit.adaptation: Two supported VMs (controlplane,node01) instead of three book VMs. Runtime/kernel preparation is supplied by the supported backend. Real package installation, kubeadm init/join, CNI, taint and per-node DNS are exercised.

semantic_audit.checks: One-minor upgrade on both nodes; actual API/node versions, original application UID/HTTP, two replicas and PDBminAvailable1 retained; final version evidence file.
Real snapshot status, deliberate deletion, restored original UID/marker, later-data removal, active restored hostPath and billion-revision bump.
Actual stopped-kubelet recovery, fresh Pod, current PodUID scheduler denial, drain relocation and replacement, uncordon, real kubelet/API authentication and authorization negatives.

semantic_audit.adaptation: Three real nested control-plane containers share a VM and one load balancer. No production physical-host resilience claim; real three-member quorum and write under one process-host outage are tested.

semantic_audit.checks: Only incorrect certificate flag repaired; live DNS, runtime version, actual CNI filenames and CSI names/absence recorded.

Actual audit delivery/rotation configuration/all four Deployment verbs/Secret metadata; mTLS allowlist, denied image, real service outage fail-closed, existing Pod execution during the outage, and recovered admission.
Existing Secret migration plus a fresh encrypted write, rawetcdheader, no plaintextmarker, APIdecryption and configmode0600.
Real service/accountgroupidentity, zeroCapEff/CapBnd,NoNewPrivs, loopback/externalHTTP, protectedmountnamespace and allowedstatewrite.
